title: OSTF Notation Profile 1.0.0
description: Native notation for OSTF 5.2. Optional alongside Core performance data. Structural validity does not prove MusicXML/engraving interoperability.

profileVersion.description: Version of the independent Notation Profile.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across all notation entities in this document.

events.description: Written notes, rests and spacers; may be empty.

performancePlanRefs.description: Explicit related Core performance plans; no automatic synchronization.

extensions.description: Namespaced opaque extension data. Unknown extensions are preserved and never executed.

WrittenPitch.description: Pitch spelling in the notation. Alteration is independent of a displayed accidental.

alter.description: Signed alteration in semitones relative to the natural letter.

octave.description: Scientific pitch octave; middle C is C4.

extensions.description: Namespaced opaque extension data. Unknown extensions are preserved and never executed.

SpelledClass.description: A spelled pitch class without an invented octave, for printed harmony symbols.

extensions.description: Namespaced opaque extension data. Unknown extensions are preserved and never executed.

Transpose.description: Add this interval to written pitch to obtain sounding pitch. The chromatic component excludes octaveChange.

octaveChange.description: Signed octaves added independently; total chromatic displacement = chromatic + 12 * octaveChange.

doubling.description: Whether an octave doubling accompanies the primary pitch.

extensions.description: Namespaced opaque extension data. Unknown extensions are preserved and never executed.

Accidental.description: Appearance of an accidental; not the source of pitch alteration.

code.description: Standard MusicXML accidental token or a namespaced extension token.

smufl.description: Optional SMuFL glyph name; availability is not guaranteed.

items.description: Beat count in an additive group.

beats.description: Ordered beat groups; [3,2] renders an additive 3+2 numerator.

beatType.description: Denominator note value: 4 is quarter, 8 is eighth.

extensions.description: Namespaced opaque extension data. Unknown extensions are preserved and never executed.

Meter.description: Displayed meter; it does not determine the actual length of every measure.

groups.description: Ordered groups for simple, additive or mixed meters.

text.description: Original display text if explicitly authored.

visible.description: Whether the time signature is printed.

line.description: Staff line counted from the bottom, starting at 1.

octaveChange.description: Octave change represented by the clef sign.

strings.description: Unique string numbers and their pitches.

Event.description: One written note, unpitched note, rest or spacer. It is not automatically a performed Core Note.

offsetQuarter.description: Exact onset from this measure start in quarter-note units.

durationQuarter.description: Exact effective notated duration in quarter-note units. Grace events alone have zero duration.

soundingPitch.description: Optional explicitly authored/resolved sounding spelling; must agree with applicable transposition when both are authoritative.

playback.description: Performance inclusion policy; absent is unspecified.

fullMeasureRest.description: Rest fills the actual referenced measure duration.

chordGroup.description: Grouping token for simultaneous chord members; not an entity reference.

notehead.description: Source notehead token or namespaced extension token.

visible.description: Whether this event is printed; hidden does not imply inaudible.

beamLevel.description: Beam level; 1 is the eighth-note beam.

octaves.description: Signed octave displacement for an octave-shift span; zero is invalid semantically.

lyricId.description: Lyric record whose extension this represents.
